figures.caption: Figure 1: Zero-shot retrieval accuracy vs. sequence length and KV count for single-hop (a) and two-hop (b) tasks. The pure SSM degrades sharply at longer sequences; SSM+Attn improves but still drops; SSM+SKA (982K params) maintains the highest accuracy and flattest profile across all settings.

Table 4: Zero-shot benchmark comparison of Echo-LM against small language models (180M parameters). All 180M models in the top section use comparable parameter budgets; the key differentiators are architecture and training data.

Figure 2: Training with action mask set to 1 for all inputs on the Tool Trace Delayed Commit tasks (short). We find that CG+SKA works fine without the action mask. The x-axis is for training steps and y-axis for log loss (left) and accuracy (right).

Figure 3: A Training run for 400k parameter Mamba-3 variants over the easy and hard System Prompt CoT Retrieval benchmark. The x-axis represents training iterations and y-axis represents training iterations and y-curve evaluation accuracy. Mamba-3 is unable to learn on this task.
